title: Sylvain Ingrid Thicket Flank
prompt:
Blue Lions push through the mid-west thicket zone. Sylvain with red-orange hair draws a Golden Deer opponent out of tree cover with relaxed spear movement while Ingrid, blonde and disciplined with a lance, cuts through long grass and low stone walls into a safe flanking position. Claude and Hilda are suggested deeper in the wooded cover by yellow markers and youthful silhouettes. This is controlled academy sparring on a tactical map, not a training lane.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded. Transition in: Golden Deer movement from the first wave leads into wooded cover. Transition out: cut on Felix seeing the northeast opening. Screen/camera rule: Blue Lions move from southeast foreground into west/center thickets; Golden Deer withdraw deeper into cover. Audio bridge: training pole clacks, footwork, whistle underlayer. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: lateral tracking frame through grass, stone wall, and thicket cover

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; use controlled academy sparring only, no blood or lethal injury. Avoid: straw targets, obstacle course, real stabbing, blood, generic faceless soldiers, wrong Sylvain hair, old faces, chaotic war, text, watermark

transition_out: cut on Felix seeing the northeast opening

risk_notes: Needs visible thicket/wooded cover and Golden Deer pressure; should not read as a training obstacle course.
